scope: Query-spectrum/positive-identity-excluded component diagnostic with Saner known checkpoint-selection candidates excluded. Fold0 negative-structure and development exposure are not ruled out. Not complete Flex CV or an independent final evaluation.
control: FPNet fold0, mean spectrum logits, measured neutral-mass window 10ppm in pinned public v2 pool
single_change: Rerank the identical baseline top25 with Saner best_validation_model, fixed RRF offset=3 and alpha=0.25
adoption: Retain as an experimental branch; do not change the main pipeline or extrapolate leaderboard gain from this small cohort.
limitations: Only three public natural-product development identities; their scores are unchanged.
The bootstrap interval includes zero; the observed mean improvement is uncertain.
Checkpoint/split declarations and identity exclusions are audited; historical producer code/minibatches are not fully reconstructed.
Nine of 32 identities belong to the fold0 monitoring cohort reconstructed from public source. The script saves last/final rather than metric-selected best; this does not prove no development contact.

Fold0 training negatives come from the full pool without heldout-identity exclusion. Actual historical sampling of these structures is unknown; positive-identity exclusion does not establish structure-unseen training.
The frozen final cohort of 250 identities was not evaluated.
Whole-stack pretrained exposure remains a separate issue.
